name: FestivalLane
theme: bright stylised anime world; one key colour per zone
note: roblox-map spec seed. Section 2 emits the BLOCKOUT from these numbers; section 3 expands this into the full roblox-map spec and runs the prover. Build from a reference image per zone, never from imagination.
axis: lanes run along +Z from the plot row; plots are spaced along X

prove: every plot gate, throw pad, dojo pad, slot sign and hub point is walkable from that plot's spawn
no player can leave the world or fall under it
every pedestal is inside its plot fence and not interpenetrating
each landing strip is flat and free of props (the food and hero must be visible)
lanes are walkable end to end
